title: hush_cut
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.12) — shape from hush-prd.md §7.1 hush_cut, FR-19, FR-20, FR-21, §8; not routed yet. Upstream: adobe/tools/hush/_upstream/jsx/host.jsx:165 HUSH.cut (entry hush_cut :333). CEP WNC_HUSH.cut (signed bridge). Contract keys are snake_case; the port translates the upstream camelCase keys (docs/adobe/phase-6b-reservations.md). Mode Cut: QE razor on every listed track at every cut boundary, remove the pieces inside the cuts, close the gaps in one pass, relink video with the audio under it (linkSelection). Backup first (clone the sequence as '<name> (Hush backup HH:MM:SS)', switch back; nothing is cut when the original cannot be made active); a locked listed track aborts with nothing cut. An empty cut list returns {removed:0, cuts:0} and touches nothing (host.jsx:168). Safety (verbatim, §8): never cut into speech, boundaries rounded inward to frames; backup before cutting; re-read track objects after every razor; gap closing in one pass; unticked tracks, locked tracks and media on disk untouched. UXP has no razor.
